Lesson 36 — Debt Service Coverage Ratio (DSCR): a practical measure investors and owners in Chester County and Montgomery County use to evaluate whether a property's income comfortably covers its debt. DSCR compares Net Operating Income to annual debt service and is central to lender underwriting, loan sizing, and risk assessment. Improve DSCR by growing reliable income streams, controlling operating expenses, and optimizing financing structures. For building owners and landlords, tracking DSCR regularly flags when cash flow stress may emerge and guides proactive decisions on rents, expense controls, capital planning, or refinancing. When preparing to buy, refinance, or manage commercial property locally, include NOI schedules and current debt statements for fast analysis. We can share a simple checklist and sample NOI schedule to help you prepare documents for underwriting reviews. Ready to see where your property stands?
